label: Frost forecast
info:
Only on a site whose dispatcher.hot_water_guard.frost.enabled is true (added by install/deploy.py).
Every 2 h: Open-Meteo hourly temperature for this site (free, no key; weather data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0) -> the lowest temperature from now until 09:00 tomorrow (or today, before 09:00) -> global frost_forecast {ts, night_min_c, frost}. The hot-water dispatcher holds the heat pump ON through a frost night. A failed fetch leaves the last forecast to go stale after 12 h, and a stale forecast means no frost hold.

name: tonight's minimum -> frost_forecast
